messages.content: 你能幫我為我和朋友共10位計劃在華盛頓州西雅圖的一天嗎？我們都是美食愛好者，想要嘗試一些海鮮和意大利菜作為午餐。晚上，我們有興趣參加一場音樂會或體育賽事。你能幫我找到適合我們的餐廳和活動嗎？

function.name: restaurant_find_group
function.description: Find restaurants suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and cuisine. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

cuisine.description: Preferred cuisine at the restaurant. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the restaurant should accommodate.

function.name: events_find_event
function.description: Find events suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and event type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

event_type.description: Type of event. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the event should accommodate.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to plan a day in Seattle for 10 people. They want lunch with seafood or Italian. Then an evening event: concert or sports. We need to find restaurants suitable for groups based on location, cuisine, group size. Also find events suitable for groups based on location, event type, group size.

We have two functions: restaurant_find_group and events_find_event. We need to call them. The user didn't specify a specific cuisine preference? They said they want to try some seafood and Italian. So we can search for both cuisines. But the function expects cuisine param as one of "Seafood" | "Italian" | "Indian" | "Chinese"[] (list). So we can pass ["Seafood", "Italian"].

We also need to find events: type "Concert" | "Sports" | "Exhibition" | "Festival"[]. They want either concert or sports. So we can pass ["Concert", "Sports"].

We need to provide location: "Seattle, WA". Group size: 10.

We need to call the functions. We'll do two calls: one for restaurants, one for events. We'll use the function calls.
